prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied cyan water creature into a clearly different body silhouette. Preserve the SAME softly painted 2D sprite style, cyan watery material, upper-left white reflections, exactly two dark blue bead eyes and no mouth or feet. The WHOLE body and every extension must be one continuous volume of water. No separate equipment or pasted shapes. Replace the previous outline as specified; changing only surface markings is insufficient. One complete neutral character facing slightly right on transparent background with generous padding. No text, shadow, particles or scenery. Make the main body a BROAD PENTAGON with five long smooth sides, wide shoulders and a broad bottom, about 1.3 times as wide as high. The water surface and outer boundary are SMOOTH, thin and continuous: remove the scalloped octagonal pressure rim and all thick edge facets completely. One upper-right shoulder flows into a narrow pointed apex with one thin swept crescent outer edge. Two tiny connected round water beads grow on the right flank. The whole face/body is an open smooth watery pentagonal shelter. Five broad sides only, no segmented border or scallops.

revisionOf.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE actual neutral source key drawing for a FOUR-combat-attribute combination in a small 2D game.
Input image 1: approved three-attribute comparison sheet, as the identity and coherent anatomical integration authority. Input image 2: approved single-attribute atlas, as material, palette and functional shape vocabulary. Both are supporting references, NOT output layouts.
Create exactly ONE complete character with ONLY the four selected attributes. Preserve the approved species and resolve all shared roots, intersections, proportions and silhouette together. One dominant continuous anatomical/material construction, sparse subordinate details, broad quiet surfaces. Do not pile four full accessories on a body, and do not import the fifth unselected attribute.
One neutral ready pose, mostly frontal with slight rightward orientation. Match the softly painted casual-game sprite style, thin crisp dark outlines, upper-left lighting, face, proportions and materials. Full subject centered on a square canvas with generous transparent padding; no edge touching or cropping.
Exactly TWO eyes, no mouth. Genuine transparent background. No labels, letters, diagrams, shadows, ground, loose particles, effects, extra poses, costumes, straps, held equipment, metal hardware, realistic anatomy or 3D toy rendering. Draw complete clean surfaces and naturally fitted connections. This is actual source artwork awaiting review, not an animation preview.

SPECIES: ONE continuous clear cyan-turquoise water volume, exactly two dark navy bead eyes, no mouth, NO FEET or limbs. Soft painterly glossy water, taut rounded facets and deep blue rim. Blade a thin swept cutting contour; piercing one long sharp apex; carapace thick octagonal liquid pressure rim; guard broad pentagonal sheltering mass; secretion tiny attached water beads. No separate shield, second polygon, ice or gemstone.
SELECTED ATTRIBUTES ONLY: blade + piercing + guard + secretion (칼날 + 관통 + 엄호 + 분비).
INTEGRATED CONSTRUCTION: One broad rounded PENTAGONAL water mass has high sheltering shoulders and a smooth liquid rim. The upper-right shoulder sweeps into a thin cutting margin that continues to ONE long sharp apex. Two tiny attached cyan beads bud from pores at the common root. One flowing body. Keep its five major corners clear; no dense octagonal armored rim or separate shell.
